title: Delta Reign is out (released Fri 6 Nov); English prices still unconfirmed
detail: The worldwide release date of 6 Nov is confirmed by the Pokémon Company. We found no post-release price data yet. The regular English Mega Rayquaza ex 084 (Double Rare) is listed around $13 as of 4 Nov by TCG Watchtower. Japanese Rayquaza prices (about $350–945) are for the Japanese set and the sources disagree, so don't use them for English.

title: Miyata Kard Market (Réunion): Delta Reign page still shows French 2nd-wave items
detail: Today's page: Bundle of 6 €44.99 (on sale), ETB €79.99 and 3-pack €19.99 sold out, single booster €7.99 and Display 36 €239.99 have unclear stock labels (the page contradicts itself). Confirm with the shop before going.

title: OP-18: Japan date still disputed (21/22 vs 28 Nov, unconfirmed)
detail: Retail sources conflict: one says a Bandai X post gives Sat 22 Nov, others list Sat 28 Nov. Nothing official found; EN date in our calendar (20 Nov) is also still unconfirmed.

title: Regionals Porto and Sydney are today (Sat 7 Nov)
detail: Results are not out yet; we'll report winners and leaders tomorrow. Limitless's tournament page showed no 7 Nov results when checked. Price checks were not run today (the collection file has no card ids for TCGdex).
